mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS is below the 20th percentile of its historical distribution, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC remains below -0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below their 3-month moving averages signal a broad-based demand contraction, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and business investment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in instances where both HOUST < 1100 and RSAFS < 500000, or the interaction effect (as measured by a two-factor model) has a Rank IC below -0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 108.0 during a supply shock regime signals reduced manufacturing output and potential inflationary pressures, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO < 108.0 in a supply shock regime, or the Rank IC falls below -0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of real GDP (GDPC1) indicates a robust economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 is above the 75th percentile of its historical distribution, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index value above 260 signals elevated inflation, which typically triggers aggressive monetary tightening and reduces equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL exceeds 260, or the Rank IC remains below -0.03 over any 6-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 150,000 and declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signal a tight labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS > 150000 and UNRATE < 3.5, or the interaction effect (as measured by a two-factor model) has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1100 during a late-cycle expansion regime signals a weakening housing sector, which often precedes economic slowdowns and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when HOUST < 1100 in a late-cycle expansion regime, or the Rank IC falls below -0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.
